primary_diagnosis_treated: Diabetic end-stage renal disease (CKD stage 5) with heavy proteinuria
nice_guideline_used: NICE NG203 (CKD assessment and management) and NG107 (Renal replacement therapy and conservative management)

medications.dose: 1.25 mg orally once daily, titrate every 2‑4 weeks to 5 mg daily as tolerated (max 10 mg)
medications.duration: Lifelong – review annually and after each titration
medications.purpose: Renoprotective RAS blockade for proteinuric CKD and hypertension
medications.nice_justification: NG203 first‑line ACE‑I/ARB for CKD with ACR ≥30 mg/mmol or hypertension; monitor creatinine & potassium after dose changes

medications.purpose: Cardiovascular risk reduction (CKD is a CVD risk equivalent)
medications.nice_justification: NG203 recommends statin for all CKD patients for CV risk reduction

medications.dose: 2.5 mg orally once daily (titrate to 5 mg if needed)
medications.purpose: Rate control for atrial fibrillation and secondary prevention after ischemic heart disease
medications.nice_justification: Guideline recommends beta‑blocker for AF/IHD; no renal dose adjustment needed

medications.purpose: Adjunct antihypertensive to achieve BP <130/80 mmHg with proteinuria
medications.nice_justification: NG203 non‑pharmacological BP target; CCB added if ACE‑I alone insufficient

medications.dose: 2–5 mg orally once daily, dose‑adjusted to INR 2.0–3.0
medications.duration: Lifelong – INR monitoring weekly for 2 weeks then monthly
medications.purpose: Stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation (eGFR <30 mL/min contraindicates DOACs)
medications.nice_justification: CKD stage 5 – DOACs contraindicated; warfarin recommended per NICE anticoagulation guidance

medications.dose: 200 mg (≈65 mg elemental iron) orally three times daily with food
medications.duration: Until ferritin >200 µg/L and TSAT >30 % (re‑check in 4 weeks), then review
medications.purpose: Correct iron deficiency before ESA use
medications.nice_justification: NG107 first‑line iron supplementation for CKD anaemia when ferritin <200 µg/L or TSAT <20 %

medications.dose: 5,000 IU subcutaneously once weekly (adjust to maintain Hb 100–120 g/L)
medications.duration: Until Hb 100–120 g/L, then review every 3 months
medications.purpose: Treat symptomatic anaemia of CKD (Hb <100 g/L) after iron repletion
medications.nice_justification: NG107 ESA indicated for CKD anaemia Hb <100 g/L after iron optimisation

medications.dose: 800 mg orally with each main meal (≈2.4 g/day)
medications.duration: Until serum phosphate <1.5 mmol/L, then review every 3 months
medications.nice_justification: NG107 phosphate binder for hyperphosphataemia; avoid calcium‑based binders if hypercalcaemia

medications.duration: Until calcium and PTH within target, then review every 3 months
medications.purpose: Manage secondary hyperparathyroidism / vitamin D deficiency
medications.nice_justification: NG107 vitamin D analogue for CKD‑MBD

medications.duration: Until serum bicarbonate ≥22 mmol/L, then review every 3 months
medications.purpose: Correct metabolic acidosis common in CKD stage 5
medications.nice_justification: NG107 sodium bicarbonate for CKD metabolic acidosis

interactions_checked.interaction: Statins can increase INR modestly; risk of over‑anticoagulation
interactions_checked.action: Monitor INR weekly for first 2 weeks after starting statin, then monthly
Avoid potassium supplements; monitor serum K⁺ 1–2 weeks after dose changes

interactions_checked.interaction: Sevelamer may reduce absorption of oral vitamin D
interactions_checked.action: Administer alfacalcidol at least 1 hour apart from sevelamer
Monitor BP and symptoms of hypotension after titration

contraindications.reason: eGFR 5.6 mL/min/1.73 m² – NICE contraindicates metformin below eGFR 30
eGFR below 20 mL/min/1.73 m² – NICE TA775 requires eGFR 20‑45 for use
contraindications.alternative: None; focus on ACE‑I and blood pressure control

contraindications.reason: CKD stage 5 – accelerate renal decline and cause fluid retention per NICE
Dual RAAS blockade increases risk of hyperkalaemia and AKI (NICE contraindication)

assumptions_warnings: Serum potassium, calcium, phosphate, PTH, bicarbonate, ferritin, TSAT, and Hb values not provided – assumed within ranges that allow initiation of listed drugs; labs will be obtained before starting.
No documented drug allergies – will verify before prescribing.
Blood pressure reading not supplied – assumed >140/90 mmHg requiring antihypertensive therapy.
Patient not currently anticoagulated – warfarin initiation assumes no contraindication such as active bleeding.
Smoking status recorded as daily – smoking cessation support will be offered.
treatment_summary: The plan initiates renoprotective ACE‑I (Ramipril), cardiovascular protection (Atorvastatin, beta‑blocker, CCB, warfarin), and CKD‑specific therapies (iron, ESA, phosphate binder, active vitamin D, sodium bicarbonate). Doses are adjusted for eGFR 5.6 mL/min, with careful monitoring of potassium, creatinine, INR, Hb, iron studies, and mineral metabolism. Contraindicated agents (metformin, SGLT2 inhibitors, NSAIDs, dual ACE‑I/ARB) are avoided. Non‑pharmacological advice includes low‑salt diet, smoking cessation, weight management, and exercise as tolerated.
